name: Hampden County, MA
findings: Hampden County has 1,400 nonprofit organizations. 449 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 361 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hampden County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Hampden County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 354 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
